beats.text: At Google, AI now writes three out of every four new lines of code.
So are programmers finished? Look at who's actually losing jobs.

beats.dir: clear, engaging explainer tone, natural pace

beats.text: Developers aged twenty-two to twenty-five? Down almost twenty percent.
AI isn't replacing engineers. It's removing the first rung of the ladder.
And the twist? In one study, experienced developers using AI were nineteen percent slower.
The full story, and what to do about it, is in our new video.
